name: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Capsule Mist | Facial Hydrating Mist with PDRN, Hyaluronic Acid & Niacinamide | 100ml
description:
Refresh and hydrate your skin anytime with the Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Capsule Mist 100ml. This lightweight facial mist is formulated with PDRN (Hydrolyzed DNA), Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide, Panthenol, Allantoin, Trehalose, Betaine, and Sodium PCA to provide convenient hydration as part of your daily skincare routine. The fine mist can be sprayed directly onto the face whenever your skin needs a refreshing boost of moisture. Its convenient spray format makes it easy to use at home, at work, or while travelling.

Key Features
PDRN & Hyaluronic Acid Formula – Contains Hydrolyzed DNA (PDRN), Sodium Hyaluronate, and Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid.
Instant Hydration – Designed for convenient hydration whenever your skin feels dry or needs refreshing.
Niacinamide Enriched – Contains Niacinamide as part of the skincare formulation.
Skin-Soothing Ingredients – Formulated with Allantoin and Panthenol.
Moisture-Supporting Formula – Includes Glycerin, Trehalose, Betaine, and Sodium PCA.
Easy Spray Application – Fine mist format allows quick and convenient facial application.
Anytime Use – Can be used throughout the day whenever additional hydration is desired.
Dermatologically Tested – Product packaging states Dermatologically Tested.
Paraben-Free – Product packaging indicates Paraben + / Free labeling; verify the exact packaging claim before publication if required.

Product Specifications
Brand: Anua
Product Name: PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Capsule Mist
Product Type: Facial Hydrating Mist
Net Volume: 100ml
Application: Face
Format: Spray Mist
Key Ingredients: PDRN, Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide, Panthenol, Allantoin

How to Use
Close your eyes and mouth.
Hold the bottle approximately 20cm away from your face.
Spray evenly over the face.
Use anytime for instant hydration.
Allow the mist to settle naturally on the skin.

Safety Information
For external use only.
Avoid direct contact with the eyes.
Close eyes and mouth during application.
Discontinue use if irritation occurs.
Keep out of reach of children.
Store according to the product packaging instructions.
